_comment: What a sandboxed interpreter needs to read besides its own prefix: the system's libraries and a few small files under /etc, never /etc itself. Mirrors crates/hx-sandbox/src/defaults.rs (hx never applies these implicitly), minus the account files: Hermes's plugin scan rejects a file that names them, and a read-only kernel does not need them. Only paths that exist are granted. Windows needs none: AppContainer reads the system through ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES.
